IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Deduplicates POST requests for 24 hours. Pre-execution rejection permits a corrected same-key retry. Once accepted or execution is uncertain, the key remains bound; changed payloads and in-progress retries return 409 conflict without starting another operation.

RateLimitReset.description: Unix time when the window resets.

Location.description: Created resource or replay observation URI.

IdempotentReplayed.description: True when the idempotency result was replayed.

RetryAfter.description: Non-negative number of seconds to wait before retrying.

AgentPatch.description: Recursive JSON Merge Patch. Every field remains typed; nested create-time required fields are optional in a patch.

status.description: A scheduled campaign waits in "scheduled" until its start time. An immediate campaign enters "running" when creation is accepted. "running" means submitted dial tasks are eligible for dialing.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent that makes the calls.

canceled.description: Was still pending when the campaign was canceled.

counts.description: Live progress. pending, calling, completed, failed, and canceled are mutually exclusive contact states and always sum to contacts.

created_at.description: When the campaign was created, ISO 8601 UTC.

started_at.description: When the campaign began dialing, ISO 8601 UTC. null while a scheduled campaign is waiting.

completed_at.description: When the last contact reached a terminal status.

max_ring_duration_ms.description: Deadline in milliseconds from dialing start to answer. Omission imposes no additional call-policy deadline.

max_call_duration_seconds.description: Deadline in seconds from answer to hangup. Omission imposes no additional call-policy deadline; lifecycle or hangup may end the call earlier.

voicemail.description: Voicemail handling policy. Omission adds no voicemail-triggered hangup.

max_silence_duration_ms.description: Hang up after this much silence from everyone on the call. Omission adds no silence hangup.

EndCallPolicy.description: Conditions under which the agent may end the call itself. All are off unless set to true.

TransferPolicy.description: Agent-initiated transfer to a person, decided from description.

ImmediateSchedule.description: timezone is required when days is set. Each weekday appears at most once.

CallingDay.description: Ranges on one weekday must not overlap.

TimeRange.description: Local wall-clock range. end must be later than start.

timezone.description: IANA timezone. start, end, and days are local to it.

start.description: Local date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, no offset) when dialing may begin.

end.description: Local date-time after which no new calls are dialed.

ScheduledSchedule.description: All times are local to timezone. end must be later than start; each weekday appears at most once.

CampaignTransport.description: How a campaign reaches its contacts. Only telephony is available at launch.

max_calls_per_second.description: Maximum new dials per second. The only dial-rate control; values above the project limit are rejected.

number.description: Phone number in E.164 format, including the leading + and country code, for example +14155552671.

name.description: Human-readable label for the carrier connection.

transport.description: Transport used to connect to the carrier.

allowed_ips.description: CIDR ranges allowed to send inbound SIP traffic.

sip_trunk.description: The inline carrier connection. Authentication credentials never appear in responses.

created_at.description: When the number was added, ISO 8601 UTC.

InboundCallPolicy.description: Call controls for inbound calls. Ringing and voicemail controls apply only to outbound calls.

port.description: Defaults to 5061 for TLS and 5060 for UDP/TCP.

password.description: A raw write-only password or a $secrets.<set>.<key> reference.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the session was created.

SessionStartResponse.description: The Session resource created by POST /sessions. The response reports only stable identity and startup state. Transport configuration and resolved transport details are never returned.

EphemeralSessionCreate.description: Start a session with an inline agent configuration that is not saved.

TransportInput.description: Connection used to start the Session. Select exactly one transport type and provide only the fields defined for that type.

SessionCreate.description: Start a session from a saved agent. Session variables replace matching saved-agent variables for this session only.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the session was created.

anyOf.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the session stopped, or null while it is active.
Human-readable status detail, when available.

BadRequest.description: The request or a field value is invalid.

example.detail: Invalid value at pipeline.llm.max_history: must be between 1 and 1024.
The requested agent was not found.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the resource state, including a bound idempotency key reused with a different payload or while its operation is in progress.

example.detail: Secret set support-prod is referenced by agent agent_k3n9x2.
The request rate limit was exceeded.

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match did not match the current resource. Retrieve it, reapply the change, and retry with the fresh ETag.

example.detail: If-Match does not match the current ETag.

SessionBadRequest.description: The request or a field value is invalid.

example.detail: Invalid value at properties.tts.vendor: unsupported value 'open_ai'.
The request does not have valid authentication credentials.

SessionForbidden.description: The project cannot use the requested service.

example.detail: Conversational AI is not enabled for this project.

SessionNotFound.description: The requested Session or a referenced Agent was not found.

example.detail: The requested Session or referenced Agent was not found.

SessionConflict.description: The request conflicts with the current Session state.

example.detail: A conflicting Session operation is already in progress.

SessionUnprocessable.description: The request is valid JSON but cannot be processed under the current resource limits.

example.detail: The project Session quota was exceeded.

SessionRateLimited.description: The request rate or concurrent Session limit was exceeded.

example.detail: The concurrent Session limit was exceeded.

SessionInternalError.description: The service encountered an internal error.

example.detail: An internal error prevented the Session from starting.

SessionBadGateway.description: An upstream service returned an invalid response.

example.detail: A required upstream service is unavailable.

SessionUnavailable.description: The Session cannot be started because resources are unavailable.

example.detail: No eligible resource is currently available to start the Session.
The Session start operation timed out.
